## About

Abdullah Bin Asim is a passionate Full Stack Developer with expertise across frontend and backend, plus AWS Generative AI credentials. His journey started with curiosity and evolved into a commitment to shipping high-quality products that solve real problems. From AI-powered platforms to full-stack web apps — he builds things that work, scale, and look great doing it.

Key strengths:
